display_name: Tasco Insurance combined motor vehicle insurance rules (Decision 53/2024/QD-BH Tasco, 22 May 2024): the whole document — contract, premium, termination, duties and deadlines, claim file, time limits, general exclusions and reductions; physical damage with its depreciation table; accident cover for people on board; goods liability; voluntary third-party liability; the fifteen additional clauses and the optional-deductible table

run.method: one agent, one session, no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md; the session was paused at a usage limit on 2026-10-06 and resumed on 2026-10-07

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the OCR text of the scanned source, in short runs checked to occur verbatim in it, and on lines marked `[page-read p.N]` where the OCR misreads the page image (each such correction is listed in NOTES.md, OCR corrections). `tools/vnsrc.py check` over every .l4 and .md except BRIEF.md ends `0 problems`.

documents.authority: standard-form contract terms published by the insurer; not law
documents.pages_viewed_as_images: all 25 at 100 dpi; pages 1, 11, 15, 16, 18, 21-25 also at 150-300 dpi

scope: The whole document: the issuing decision (effective date), the opening paragraph, the 19 definitions, Chương I (Điều 1-13), Chương II (Điều 14-19 with the depreciation table), Chương III (Điều 20-25), Chương IV (Điều 26-29), Chương V (Điều 30-34), Chương VI (BS01-BS15) and Điều 35-36. Inputs, not encoded: what the certificate states, Decree 67/2023 (payment table, compulsory limits, exclusions), the road traffic law, the Civil Code, and Tasco's own determinations (market value, the rate within Điều 13's ranges, share of fault). Gaps in the text are named refusals: Điều 6 (in-time notice with no agreement and no request), Điều 24 (permanent partial disability), BS04 (contracts under 12 months), and missing inputs for Điều 13.1.2-1.3 and 24.2. See NOTES.md sections 1-2 (119 coverage rows: 89 encoded, 30 inert, none deferred).
vintage: the rules as issued on 22 May 2024 by Decision 53/2024; the document states no end date and no replacement

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this encoding against the source. No independent test pass has been run. Every expected value in the tests was written by the same session that wrote the rules (worked by hand from the source, with the arithmetic beside each group); the depreciation-table and Điều 35 assertions were generated from the page transcription and the OCR lines respectively.

self_check.vnsrc: vnsrc check: 908 src: lines, 1272 Vietnamese runs, 0 problems (every .l4 and .md except BRIEF.md)

forks.F1: Decision art 2: effect from 22 May 2024, the date on the signed decision.
forks.F2: Definition 7: months of use are the difference between the two calendar months.
forks.F3: Definition 7: the period of use ends at the month the contract was concluded, not at the loss.
forks.F5: Điều 2: with no agreed time for payment, the contract has effect on a day only if the premium was paid in full by that day.
forks.F7: Every bare 'ngày' is a calendar day; 13.1.2(a)'s 'ngày làm việc' is the only working-day period.
forks.F8: Điều 1: the insurance period includes both its first and last days.
forks.F9: 'ngay' (immediately) carries no number; encoded as a fact and as a duty with no WITHIN.
forks.F10: Điều 6: a late notice ends the contract at the transfer even where the old owner agreed to pass it on (6.2 over 6.1).
forks.F11: Điều 6.2 refunds by Điều 3.2's owner limb where the owner asked to end it, by Tasco's limb on a late notice.
forks.F12: Điều 4.2.3: when a file Tasco cannot verify is complete is left to the caller.
forks.F13: Điều 9.1: Tasco's share applied to what Tasco would pay alone.
forks.F14: 'kinh doanh' (Điều 18 table) and 'KDVT' (Điều 35) read as one fact.
forks.F15: Điều 10.1: the last day is the anniversary of the event plus the force-majeure days.
forks.F16: Điều 11.4: the drug limb is governed by 'damage to property' as the alcohol limb is.
forks.F17: Overload of a vehicle carrying goods and people: the larger excess.
forks.F18: Điều 13.1.1(a): both Tasco-notice failures needed; the police limb separate; force majeure or Tasco's assessment spares all.
forks.F19: Chương V applies Điều 33 alone, not Điều 11.
forks.F20: Điều 14.1's 'sudden, unforeseen' applies to every case but natural catastrophe.
forks.F21: Điều 18.1.2(c): 'the first year of use' is 12 months of use or less.
forks.F22: Điều 19.2: the deductible is compared with the loss after depreciation and the under-insurance ratio.
forks.F23: Điều 13's reduction does not reach the costs of Điều 14.2.
forks.F24: BS03, BS04, BS15: '10% of the compensation' is of the amount before the deductible, and the clause's deductible replaces Điều 19's.
forks.F25: Điều 18.1.2(a) applies its ratio to the depreciated cost of (b).
forks.F26: Điều 22: the accident sum insured is per person.
forks.F27: Điều 24.2: the decree table's percentage is applied to the sum insured.
forks.F28: Điều 24.4: a child under 7 gets half of what an adult would.
forks.F29: Điều 24.4: the child and overcrowding adjustments both apply.
forks.F30: Chương IV: deductible, then reduction, then the cap.
forks.F31: Chương V bodily injury: the lesser of Điều 34.1's formula and Điều 32's excess over the compulsory limit.
forks.F32: Điều 34.2: the lesser of the owner's payment and damage times fault, less the compulsory limit, capped at the voluntary limit.
forks.F33: Điều 33.3 does not carry Điều 11.1's three spared causes of lapse.
forks.F34: BS07: the day of the loss is day 1 of the four deductible days.
forks.F35: BS15 is computed on its own, not combined with the Chương II payment.
forks.F36: Điều 35: the chosen deductible is charged on partial losses only.
forks.F37: BS11: each item of added equipment is paid up to its own sum insured.
forks.LAW-1: Điều 3.2's 70% refund is not found in Law 08/2022 Art 26-27 (lines 623-678); not resolved.
forks.LAW-2: Over-insurance: Law Art 47 (lines 933-952) pays market value at the loss; not encoded.
forks.LAW-3: Late payment interest: Law Art 31.2 (lines 725-729); the rules are silent; not encoded.
